mapper.select: select *,pp.P_Name as pname,pr.Pr_Code as prCode from Fund_Number_Info fni left join Pre_Project pp on fni.P_Id = pp.P_ID left join Payment_Receipt pr on fni.Pr_ID = pr.id where fni.state !=3 and fni.id = #{id}

select *,pp.P_Name as pname,pr.Pr_Code as prCode from Fund_Number_Info fni left join Pre_Project pp on fni.P_Id = pp.P_ID left join Payment_Receipt pr on fni.pr_id = pr.id
fni.state !=3
and fni.p_id = #{params.pId}
and likePname(#{params.pName},pp.P_Id)=true
and pp.P_Name like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
and fni.fn_name like concat('%',#{params.fnName},'%')
and fni.fn_code = #{params.fnCode}

select *,pp.P_Name as pname,pr.Pr_Code as prCode from Fund_Number_Info fni left join Pre_Project pp on fni.P_Id = pp.P_ID left join Payment_Receipt pr on fni.pr_id = pr.id where fni.P_Id = #{pId} and fni.state =7 and fni.Fn_Amount>0
